thi-ap31:2.1: purimaṁ → parikammañca (sya-all) | kammaṁ → parikammañca kusalaṁ (cck: syā.) | kusalaṁ → S2 kammakusalaṁ. (pts note)
thi-ap31:2.2: sādhupatthitaṁ → sādhū patthitaṁ (bj) | patthitaṁ → S1 sampatthitaṁ; S2 atthi taṁ. (pts note)
thi-ap31:3.2: sāvakānañca patthitaṁ → buddhānaṁ sāvakāna ca (bj) | patthitaṁ → buddhānaṁ sāvakānañca (cck: sī. ka.)
thi-ap31:3.3: paribhogamayaṁ → paribhogaṁ mayā (sya-all) | ayaṁ → S1 mayaṁ. (pts note)
thi-ap31:4.1: uccanīcamayaṁ → uccānīcaṁ mayā (sya-all) | Uccānīcam → S1 uccānica. (pts note)
thi-ap31:4.2: sādhupatthitaṁ uccākulaparikammaṁ katametaṁ → sādhu patthitaṁ uccākulaparikkammaṁ katamhehi (sya-all) | bhikkhūnaṁ → S1 bhikkhunī. (pts note)
thi-ap31:4.4: mahāmune → katamhehi mahāmune (cck: syā. pī.) | amhehi → S1 katam etaṁ. (pts note)
thi-ap31:5.3: mānusikamatikkantā → mānussikam anikkantā (pts) | anikkantā → S1 -atikkantā; S2 mānussakaṁ-. (pts note)
thi-ap31:6.1: uppatte ca → upacite (sya-all) | kamme → S1 uppatte 'va kate-; S2 uppatte tato kamme. (pts note)
thi-ap31:6.2: vāpi → cāpi (bj, sya-all) | jātiyā → S2 jāyā. (pts note) | cāpi → S1 vāpi. (pts note)
thi-ap31:6.4: kulasambhavā → kulasamhavā (bj) | khattiyā → S1 janā khattiye. (pts note)
thi-ap31:8.4: sabbā → S2 sabbe. (pts note) | amha → S1 pattāmha. (pts note)
thi-ap31:9.3: bahū → bahuṁ (pts) | bahuṁ → S1 bahu; S2 bahū. (pts note)
